---
title: "About GPT Sherpa"
pagetitle: "About — GPT Sherpa"
---

GPT Sherpa is a working data scientist's notebook of LLM patterns, made
public. It collects the parts that have survived contact with real projects —
Claude Code setup, project control documents (`CLAUDE.md`), Quarto authoring,
knowledge workflows, and copy-paste templates.

## Who

I'm [Harlan Nelson](https://www.linkedin.com/in/harlananelson/), a clinical
data scientist. Personal site:
[harlananelson.com](https://harlananelson.com). I publish here when a
pattern is generic enough to be reusable by anyone working with LLMs.

## Source

All content lives in the public
[`llmcheatsheets`](https://github.com/harlananelson/llmcheatsheets) repo on
GitHub. Text is MIT-licensed; code samples are MIT-licensed (see the
[`LICENSE`](https://github.com/harlananelson/llmcheatsheets/blob/main/LICENSE)
and
[`LICENSE-CODE`](https://github.com/harlananelson/llmcheatsheets/blob/main/LICENSE-CODE)
files in the repo).

## What's not on the site

Some material is deliberately employer-specific and lives in a private
companion repo. You won't see Databricks workspace IDs, employer-internal
server names, internal project names, or any clinical data here. Patterns
get generalized — and any employer-specific details stripped — before
they're published.

## Suggestions and corrections

Open an issue on the
[llmcheatsheets GitHub repo](https://github.com/harlananelson/llmcheatsheets/issues).
